description: A tiered credential, stated without flattery or shame. It reports how far a party has been vouched for, and the lowest tier is a starting position rather than a warning.

MUST: Distinguish the tier by a non-colour signal as well as colour — a count of filled marks, not a hue.
Carry the tier's name as text. A badge that is only marks is a puzzle.
Give the lowest tier the same neutral treatment as every other tier.
Render legibly over media, on a scrim, at the same size it renders on a surface.
SHOULD: Read as one node to assistive technology: the tier name and its position in the ladder, not a row of marks.
NEVER: Use destructive or warning ink for an unattained tier. Not yet verified is not an error.
Accompany the lowest tier with the word 'unverified' or any negation of the ladder's own vocabulary.
Imply a tier the platform has not actually confirmed.
